prometheus_tsdb_wal_writes_failed_total.help: Total number of write log writes that failed.

sysContact.help: The textual identification of the contact person for this managed node, together with information on how to contact this person - 1.3.6.1.2.1.1.4

sysDescr.help: A textual description of the entity - 1.3.6.1.2.1.1.1

sysLocation.help: The physical location of this node (e.g., 'telephone closet, 3rd floor') - 1.3.6.1.2.1.1.6

sysName.help: An administratively-assigned name for this managed node - 1.3.6.1.2.1.1.5

sysORDescr.help: A textual description of the capabilities identified by the corresponding instance of sysORID. - 1.3.6.1.2.1.1.9.1.3

sysORID.help: An authoritative identification of a capabilities statement with respect to various MIB modules supported by the local SNMP application acting as a command responder. - 1.3.6.1.2.1.1.9.1.2

sysObjectID.help: The vendor's authoritative identification of the network management subsystem contained in the entity - 1.3.6.1.2.1.1.2

sysServices.help: A value which indicates the set of services that this entity may potentially offer - 1.3.6.1.2.1.1.7

sysUpTime.help: The time (in hundredths of a second) since the network management portion of the system was last re-initialized. - 1.3.6.1.2.1.1.3
